reservation.note: Reserved allocations were not charged as spent work. Control reserve further reduces a candidate call budget; no counterfactual reallocation was executed.

native_reference_summary.status: Native specialist reference has separate wall-time accounting; no equal-unit primary comparison is asserted

interpretation.proximate_failure: Fixed acquisition allocation plus conservative complete-pipeline preflight exhausted exploration before one candidate completed six training cases; the economic admission gate was never reached.
interpretation.implementation_defect_status: No corrupt result, invalid primary paid training output, or contradiction of frozen stop logic was found. Allocation incompatibility and growing full-history checkpoint costs are design/engineering deficiencies, not proof that a completed candidate would have won.
interpretation.shared_account: Service and improvement consumed one cumulative account; research artifacts enlarged repeatedly serialized checkpoints.
interpretation.terminal_failure: A stage is marked completed before acquisition; failed dispatch is not retried, so descendants lacking an admitted parent defer.
interpretation.transfer_evidence: No primary admitted parent exists. Diagnostic inherited construction is cheaper than exact reconstruction but more costly and one qualified result worse than the strong parent-free alternative.
interpretation.repair_lineage: Repair tasks were generated from independent conventional-portfolio baselines, not actual accepted preceding mission outputs. Stored ancestry alone cannot establish use.
interpretation.representation: Finite dispatch-weight/lookahead/repair grammar did not preserve a reusable world-specific computational representation across unrelated random DAGs. This is a plausible limit, not a tested proof of impossibility.
interpretation.economic_gate: The old net-benefit gate charged all acquisition against a no-research counterfactual and conflated full-investment recovery with marginal adoption. It was not exercised in the primary flywheel.
interpretation.nonclaim: Do not repair this code and rerun the old confirmation as fresh evidence; do not attribute portfolio/workflow contrasts to retention when no asset was retained.

next_hypotheses.claim: A family with repeated immutable structure and changed queries can repay a reusable representation.
next_hypotheses.decisive_test: Bound candidate domains prospectively; compare competent direct, conventional reuse, cheapest equivalent builder, and inherited constructions on new task identities.

next_hypotheses.claim: Separately enforced service/improvement accounts preserve mission delivery during failed research.
next_hypotheses.decisive_test: Exhaust improvement account, then verify incumbent service and authority remain intact within funded service limits.

next_hypotheses.claim: An accepted representation can reduce construction of a distinct successor capability.
next_hypotheses.decisive_test: Use the actual accepted predecessor output/state; measure parent calls and removed-with-rebuild versus strong parent-free and independent equivalent construction.

next_hypotheses.claim: Measured released capacity can fund a bounded next construction.
next_hypotheses.decisive_test: Use enforceable reusable capacity, debit it to the child construction; distinguish this from abstract operations and externally supplied research budget.
